positive_103_mode0.mechanism: Raw RX75 0.16 family joint L1 weights change; 104,105 crosses start-preparation 0.16 threshold. Contracted family is refitted and becomes multistart0 path index0, which wins validation. No accepted greedy step is part of the selected model.

negative_102_mode0.mechanism: RNJ raw RX75 0.24 drops native block 101,103,104,105, creating a 21-support coarse candidate. This candidate already omits true 103,104,105 and retains false 104,105; removal of another false native block reduces its stored size. It is within 3% of validation best and now wins by size. This degradation is already present in RNJ-only selection.

summary.scope: Six already evaluated N96 high-noise cells; post-fit mechanism audit, not a learned or validated price rule; full scan and independent numerical audit are separate.

conditions: The smaller physical true support family is a feasible subfamily of the larger family.
The extra block is laminar with every retained support.
All shared coefficients have the same bounds and the extra R/X coefficients may be zero.
The objective is unpenalized mean L1 on identical observed data.
nested_extra_block_obstruction.mathematical_fact: With identical data, loss normalization and weight bounds, zero-allowed weights imply J(F_true union C) <= J(F_true) for every P,Q,Y, including every DR realization.
nested_extra_block_obstruction.proof: For every feasible coefficient vector on F_true, retain its shared coordinates and append r_C=x_C=0. This is feasible on F_true union C and gives exactly the same prediction and loss, so minimizing on the larger family cannot increase the objective.
nested_extra_block_obstruction.search_implication: Deletion of this compatible extra block alone cannot strictly improve training L1; adding any true block cannot delete it through crossing repair. Its removal requires coefficients becoming zero after another joint refit, explicit contraction/initialization, or a complexity/validation selection mechanism.
nested_extra_block_obstruction.scope: This is a fixed-family nesting fact, independent of correct physical model specification. It does not forbid deletion after a different crossing move or infer that price can never affect fitted coefficients.
